      die "cannot check out default branch: ${default_branch}" "Check \`chezmoi git -- status\` in ${CHEZMOI_SRC}"
    fi
    echo "checked out: ${default_branch} (branch '${current_branch}' was clean and merged)"
  fi

  local remote_branch="$default_branch"
  [[ -n "$branch_arg" ]] && remote_branch="$branch_arg"

  local remote_commits
  remote_commits=$({ chezmoi git -- log --oneline "HEAD..origin/${remote_branch}" 2>/dev/null || true; } | wc -l)

  if [[ "$remote_commits" -eq 0 && "$force" != "true" ]]; then
    echo "sync: already up to date"
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi status\` for current state"
    return 0
  fi

  if [[ "$remote_commits" -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "found: ${remote_commits} new commits on remote"
  else
    echo "sync: no new commits, applying to resolve local drift"
  fi

  if [[ "$preview" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "diffs:"
    chezmoi git -- diff --stat "HEAD" "origin/${remote_branch}" 2>/dev/null || true
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi sync\` to apply these changes"
    return 0
  fi

  local update_args=()
  [[ "$force" == "true" ]] && update_args+=(--force)

  local output
  if output=$(chezmoi update "${update_args[@]}" 2>&1); then
    echo "sync: pulled and applied${force:+ (force)}"
  else
    echo "error: chezmoi update failed"
    echo "$output" | head -10
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi diff\` to review what failed"
    return 1
  fi
  help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi verify\` to confirm state"
}

src_to_target() {
  local src_rel="$1" path="$1"
  local was_dot=false was_private=false
  [[ "$src_rel" == dot_* ]] && was_dot=true
  [[ "$src_rel" == private_* ]] && was_private=true
  path="${path#dot_}"
  path="${path#private_}"
  path="${path#executable_}"
  path="${path#encrypted_}"
  path="${path#symlink_}"
  path="${path#run_once_}"
  path="${path#run_onchange_}"
  path="${path#run_onchange_after_}"
  path="${path#run_onchange_before_}"
  if [[ "$was_dot" == "true" ]]; then
    path=".${path}"
  elif [[ "$was_private" == "true" && "$src_rel" == private_dot_* ]]; then
    path=".${path}"
  fi
  path="${path%.tmpl}"
  path="${path%.age}"
  echo "~/${path}"
}

classify_group() {
  local base="$1"
  case "$base" in
    executable_*)  echo "Scripts" ;;
    symlink_*)     echo "Symlinks" ;;
    encrypted_*)   echo "Encrypted" ;;
    *.service.tmpl|*.service) echo "Systemd Units" ;;
    *.timer)       echo "Timers" ;;
    run_once_*)    echo "Run-Once Scripts" ;;
    run_onchange_*) echo "Run-Onchange Scripts" ;;
    *.tmpl)        echo "Templates" ;;
    dot_*)         echo "Config Files" ;;
    private_*)     echo "Private Files" ;;
    *)             echo "Other Files" ;;
  esac
}

classify_label() {
  local kind="$1"
  case "$kind" in
    script)      echo "Shell script" ;;
    symlink)     echo "Symlink" ;;
    encrypted)   echo "Age-encrypted file" ;;
    svc)         echo "Systemd service unit" ;;
    timer)       echo "Systemd timer unit" ;;
    run-once)    echo "Run-once script" ;;
    run-onchange) echo "Run-onchange script" ;;
    template)    echo "Chezmoi template" ;;
    config)      echo "Config file" ;;
    private)     echo "Private file" ;;
    *)           echo "File" ;;
  esac
}

graph_write_latmd() {
  local nodes_file="$1" edges_file="$2" node_count="$3" edge_count="$4" out_path="$5"

  local hubs_tmp
  hubs_tmp=$(mktemp)
  cut -d'|' -f2 "$edges_file" > "$hubs_tmp" || true
  local hub_lines
  hub_lines=$(sort "$hubs_tmp" 2>/dev/null | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10 || true)

  local edge_kinds
  edge_kinds=$(cut -d'|' -f3 "$edges_file" 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn || true)

  local out_dir
  out_dir=$(dirname "$out_path")
  mkdir -p "$out_dir"

  {
    echo "graph:"
    echo "  generated-by: chezmoi-axi graph --output"
    echo "  generated-at: $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
    echo "  nodes: ${node_count}"
    echo "  edges: ${edge_count}"

    echo ""
    echo "edge_kinds:"
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
      echo "  ${line}"
    done <<< "$edge_kinds"

    echo ""
    echo "hubs[10]{node,edges_in}:"
    if [[ -n "$hub_lines" ]]; then
      while IFS= read -r line; do
        [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
        local count node
        count=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $1}')
        node=$(echo "$line" | awk '{$1=""; print}' | sed 's/^ //')
        echo "  ${node},${count}"
      done <<< "$hub_lines"
    else
      echo "  (none)"
    fi

    echo ""
    echo "index[${node_count}]{group,node,target}:"
    local current_group=""
    while IFS= read -r rel; do
      [[ -z "$rel" ]] && continue
      local base group target_path
      base=$(basename "$rel")
      group=$(classify_group "$base")
      target_path=$(src_to_target "$rel")
      echo "  ${group},${rel},${target_path}"
    done < <(sort "$nodes_file")

    echo ""
    echo "nodes[${node_count}]{source,type,target,outgoing,incoming}:"
    while IFS= read -r rel; do
      [[ -z "$rel" ]] && continue
      local base kind kind_label target_path
      base=$(basename "$rel")
      kind=$(classify "$base")
      kind_label=$(classify_label "$kind")
      target_path=$(src_to_target "$rel")

      local out_edges in_edges
      out_edges=$(grep "^${rel}|" "$edges_file" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)
      in_edges=$(grep "|${rel}|" "$edges_file" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)

      echo "  ${rel},${kind},${target_path},${out_edges},${in_edges}"

      local edges_for_node
      edges_for_node=$(grep "^${rel}|" "$edges_file" 2>/dev/null | sort || true)
      if [[ -n "$edges_for_node" ]]; then
        echo "  outgoing:"
        while IFS='|' read -r from to ekind; do
          [[ -z "$ekind" ]] && continue
          echo "    ${ekind},${to}"
        done <<< "$edges_for_node"
      fi

      local incoming
      incoming=$(grep "|${rel}|" "$edges_file" 2>/dev/null | sort || true)
      if [[ -n "$incoming" ]]; then
        echo "  incoming:"
        while IFS='|' read -r ifrom ito ikind; do
          [[ -z "$ikind" ]] && continue
          echo "    ${ikind},${ifrom}"
        done <<< "$incoming"
      fi
    done < <(sort "$nodes_file")

  } > "$out_path"

  rm -f "$hubs_tmp"
}

cmd_graph() {
  local node_limit=50 edge_limit=100 full=false output=""
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --full)   full=true; shift ;;
      --nodes)  node_limit="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --edges)  edge_limit="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --output) output="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      -h|--help)
        echo "Usage: chezmoi-axi graph [--full] [--nodes N] [--edges N] [--output <file>]"
        echo "  --full       Show all nodes and edges (bypass caps)"
        echo "  --nodes N    Max nodes to display (default 50)"
        echo "  --edges N    Max edges to display (default 100)"
        echo "  --output F   Write graph as lat.md-style markdown to file (implies --full)"
        echo ""
        echo "Parses the chezmoi source tree into a relationship graph:"
        echo "  source->target   filename conventions (dot_ executable_ symlink_ .tmpl)"
        echo "  template->var    {{ .chezmoi.* }} and {{ .custom }} references"
        echo "  unit->exec       ExecStart= in systemd units"
        echo "  unit->dep        After= Requires= Wants= in systemd units"
        echo "  timer->unit      Unit= in timer files (implicit by name)"
        echo "  script->source   source/. commands in shell scripts"
        echo "  script->bin      command calls via \$HOME/.local/bin references"
        echo "  symlink->target  symlink_ prefix resolution"
        echo "  var-def          variable definitions (export VAR=, Environment=VAR=)"
        echo "  var-ref          variable references (\$VAR, \${VAR})"
        echo "  md-wikilink     [[wikilink]] references in markdown files"
        echo "  md-link          [text](relative-path) links in markdown files"
        echo ""
        echo "With --output, writes a lat.md-convention markdown file:"
        echo "  - Index with wiki links at the top"
        echo "  - Sections grouped by domain concept"
        echo "  - Each node has a heading, leading paragraph, and edge listings"
        echo "  - Cross-references use [[wiki-link]] syntax"
        exit 0 ;;
      --output=*) output="${1#--output=}"; shift ;;
      -*) usage_error "unknown flag: $1" "chezmoi-axi graph [--full] [--nodes N] [--edges N] [--output <file>]" ;;
      *)  usage_error "unexpected argument: $1" "chezmoi-axi graph [--full] [--nodes N] [--edges N] [--output <file>]" ;;
    esac
  done

  [[ -n "$output" ]] && full=true

  if ! command -v rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    die "ripgrep (rg) is required but not found on PATH" "Install ripgrep: https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep"
  fi

  [[ ! -d "$CHEZMOI_SRC" ]] && die "chezmoi source dir not found: $CHEZMOI_SRC" "Run \`chezmoi init\` first"

  local tmp_nodes tmp_edges
  tmp_nodes=$(mktemp)
  tmp_edges=$(mktemp)

  : > "$tmp_nodes"
  : > "$tmp_edges"

  add_node() {
    local rel="$1"
    grep -qxF "$rel" "$tmp_nodes" 2>/dev/null && return 0
    echo "$rel" >> "$tmp_nodes"
  }

  add_edge() {
    local from="$1" to="$2" kind="$3"
    local line="${from}|${to}|${kind}"
    grep -qxF "$line" "$tmp_edges" 2>/dev/null && return 0
    echo "$line" >> "$tmp_edges"
  }

  classify() {
    local base="$1"
    case "$base" in
      executable_*)  echo "script" ;;
      symlink_*)     echo "symlink" ;;
      encrypted_*)   echo "encrypted" ;;
      *.service.tmpl) echo "svc" ;;
      *.service)     echo "svc" ;;
      *.timer)       echo "timer" ;;
      run_once_*)    echo "run-once" ;;
      run_onchange_*) echo "run-onchange" ;;
      *.tmpl)        echo "template" ;;
      dot_*)         echo "config" ;;
      private_*)     echo "private" ;;
      *)             echo "file" ;;
    esac
  }

  while IFS= read -r -d '' src; do
    local base
    base=$(basename "$src")
    [[ "$base" == .* ]] && continue
    [[ "$base" == *.bak ]] && continue
    local rel="${src#"$CHEZMOI_SRC/"}"
    add_node "$rel"
  done < <(find "$CHEZMOI_SRC" -type f -not -path '*/.git/*' -print0 | sort -z)

  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    [[ -z "$rel" ]] && continue
    local base
    base=$(basename "$rel")
    local target_path
    target_path=$(src_to_target "$rel")

    case "$base" in
      dot_*|executable_*|encrypted_*|private_*|run_once_*|run_onchange_*)
        add_edge "$rel" "$target_path" "source->target"
        ;;
      symlink_*)
        local link_target
        link_target=$(readlink "${CHEZMOI_SRC}/${rel}" 2>/dev/null || true)
        [[ -n "$link_target" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$link_target" "symlink->target"
        add_edge "$rel" "$target_path" "source->target"
        ;;
    esac
  done < "$tmp_nodes"

  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    [[ -z "$rel" ]] && continue
    local full_path="${CHEZMOI_SRC}/${rel}"
    local base
    base=$(basename "$rel")

    if [[ "$base" == *.tmpl ]]; then
      local vars
      vars=$(rg -o '\{\{\s*\.([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_.]*)' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null \
        | sed 's/{{ *\.//' | sort -u || true)
      local v
      for v in $vars; do
        add_edge "$rel" "{{ .${v} }}" "template->var"
      done
    fi

    case "$base" in
      *.service|*.service.tmpl)
        local exec_lines deps wanted_by
        exec_lines=$(rg -o 'ExecStart[^\n]*' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        while IFS= read -r el; do
          [[ -z "$el" ]] && continue
          local cmd
          cmd=$(echo "$el" \
            | sed 's/^ExecStart[= ]*//' \
            | sed 's/%h/$HOME/g' \
            | sed 's/{{ *\.chezmoi\.homeDir *}}/$HOME/g')
          local bin_name
          bin_name=$(echo "$cmd" | awk '{print $1}' | sed 's|.*/||')
          [[ -n "$bin_name" && "$bin_name" != *"="{{* ]] \
            && add_edge "$rel" "$bin_name" "unit->exec"
        done <<< "$exec_lines"

        deps=$(rg -o '(?:After|Requires|Wants)=[^\n]*' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        while IFS= read -r dl; do
          [[ -z "$dl" ]] && continue
          local dep_name
          dep_name=$(echo "$dl" | sed 's/^\(After\|Requires\|Wants\)=//' | cut -d' ' -f1)
          [[ -n "$dep_name" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$dep_name" "unit->dep"
        done <<< "$deps"

        wanted_by=$(rg -o 'WantedBy=[^\n]*' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        while IFS= read -r wb; do
          [[ -z "$wb" ]] && continue
          local target
          target=$(echo "$wb" | sed 's/^WantedBy=//' | cut -d' ' -f1)
          [[ -n "$target" ]] && add_edge "$target" "$rel" "target->unit"
        done <<< "$wanted_by"
        ;;
      *.timer)
        local unit_ref
        unit_ref=$(rg -o 'Unit=[^\n]*' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        if [[ -n "$unit_ref" ]]; then
          local timer_target
          timer_target=$(echo "$unit_ref" | sed 's/^Unit=//' | cut -d' ' -f1)
          [[ -n "$timer_target" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$timer_target" "timer->unit"
        else
          local implied
          implied=$(echo "$rel" | sed 's/\.timer$//')
          add_edge "$rel" "${implied}.service" "timer->unit"
        fi
        ;;
    esac

    case "$base" in
      executable_*|run_once_*|run_onchange_*|dot_bashrc|dot_zshrc|dot_profile)
        local source_refs bin_refs
        source_refs=$(rg -o '(?:source|\.)\s+[$~/][^ "'\''
;&|]+' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        while IFS= read -r s; do
          [[ -z "$s" ]] && continue
          s=$(echo "$s" | sed 's/^[a-z]*[[:space:]]*//' | sed 's/\$HOME/~/g' | sed 's/%h/~/g')
          add_edge "$rel" "$s" "script->source"
        done <<< "$source_refs"

        bin_refs=$(rg -o '\$HOME/\.local/bin/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        local b
        for b in $(echo "$bin_refs" | sed 's|.*bin/||' | sort -u); do
          [[ -n "$b" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$b" "script->bin"
        done
        ;;
    esac

    # --- Variable definitions: export VAR=, VAR= (assignments), Environment=VAR= in systemd ---
    case "$base" in
      dot_bashrc|dot_zshrc|dot_zshenv.tmpl|dot_zshenv|dot_profile|\
      executable_*|run_once_*|run_onchange_*)
        local var_defs
        var_defs=$(rg -o '(?:^|;|\s)(?:export\s+)?[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*=' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null \
          | sed 's/^.*export[[:space:]]*//' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | sed 's/=.*//' | sort -u || true)
        local vd
        for vd in $var_defs; do
          [[ -n "$vd" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$vd" "var-def"
        done
        ;;
      *.service|*.service.tmpl)
        local env_defs
        env_defs=$(rg -o 'Environment(?:=|[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*=)[^\n]*' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        while IFS= read -r ed; do
          [[ -z "$ed" ]] && continue
          local env_name
          env_name=$(echo "$ed" | sed 's/^Environment[= ]*//' | sed 's/=.*//' | cut -d' ' -f1)
          [[ -n "$env_name" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$env_name" "var-def"
        done <<< "$env_defs"
        ;;
    esac

    # --- Variable references: $VAR and ${VAR} ---
    case "$base" in
      dot_bashrc|dot_zshrc|dot_zshenv.tmpl|dot_zshenv|dot_profile|\
      executable_*|run_once_*|run_onchange_*)
        local var_refs
        var_refs=$(rg -o '\$\{[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*\}|\$[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null \
          | sed 's/^\${\|^\$//' | sed 's/}$//' | sort -u || true)
        local vr
        for vr in $var_refs; do
          [[ -n "$vr" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$vr" "var-ref"
        done
        ;;
    esac

    # --- Markdown cross-references: [[wikilinks]] and [text](relative-path) ---
    case "$base" in
      *.md)
        local wiki_refs
        wiki_refs=$(rg -o '\[\[([^\]|#]+)(?:#[^\]]+)?\]\]' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null \
          | sed 's/^\[\[//' | sed 's/\]\]$//' | sed 's/#.*//' | sort -u || true)
        local wr
        for wr in $wiki_refs; do
          [[ -n "$wr" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$wr" "md-wikilink"
        done

        local md_links
        md_links=$(rg -o '\[[^\]]+\]\((?!https?://)([^)]+)\)' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null \
          | sed 's/.*(\(.*\))/\1/' | sort -u || true)
        local ml
        for ml in $md_links; do
          [[ -n "$ml" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$ml" "md-link"
        done
        ;;
    esac
  done < "$tmp_nodes"

  local node_count edge_count
  node_count=$(wc -l < "$tmp_nodes")
  edge_count=$(wc -l < "$tmp_edges")

  if (( node_count == 0 )); then
    rm -f "$tmp_nodes" "$tmp_edges"
    echo "graph: 0 nodes found in source tree"
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi status\` to check source state"
    return 0
  fi

  if [[ -n "$output" ]]; then
    graph_write_latmd "$tmp_nodes" "$tmp_edges" "$node_count" "$edge_count" "$output"
    rm -f "$tmp_nodes" "$tmp_edges"
    echo "graph: wrote ${node_count} nodes, ${edge_count} edges to ${output}"
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi graph\` for TOON output to stdout"
    return 0
  fi

  local hubs_tmp
  hubs_tmp=$(mktemp)

  cut -d'|' -f2 "$tmp_edges" > "$hubs_tmp"
  local hub_lines
  hub_lines=$(sort "$hubs_tmp" | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10)

  local edge_kinds
  edge_kinds=$(cut -d'|' -f3 "$tmp_edges" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn)

  if [[ "$full" != "true" ]]; then
    local disp_n="$node_count" disp_e="$edge_count"
    if (( node_count > node_limit )); then disp_n="$node_limit"; fi
    if (( edge_count > edge_limit )); then disp_e="$edge_limit"; fi

    echo "graph:"
    if (( node_count > node_limit )); then
      echo "  nodes: ${disp_n} of ${node_count} total"
    else
      echo "  nodes: ${disp_n}"
    fi
    if (( edge_count > edge_limit )); then
      echo "  edges: ${disp_e} of ${edge_count} total"
    else
      echo "  edges: ${disp_e}"
    fi
  else
    echo "graph:"
    echo "  nodes: ${node_count}"
    echo "  edges: ${edge_count}"
  fi

  echo ""
  echo "edge_kinds:"
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
    echo "  $line"
  done <<< "$edge_kinds"

  if [[ -n "$hub_lines" ]]; then
    echo ""
    echo "hubs[10]{node,edges_in}:"
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
      local count node
      count=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $1}')
      node=$(echo "$line" | awk '{$1=""; print}' | sed 's/^ //')
      echo "  ${node},${count}"
    done <<< "$hub_lines"
  fi

  local show_n=$node_count
  [[ "$full" != "true" && "$node_count" -gt "$node_limit" ]] && show_n=$node_limit
  echo ""
  echo "nodes[${show_n}]{source,type}:"
  local n=0
  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    [[ -z "$rel" ]] && continue
    (( n >= show_n )) && break
    echo "  ${rel},$(classify "$(basename "$rel")")"
    (( n++ )) || true
  done < <(sort "$tmp_nodes")

  local show_e=$edge_count
  [[ "$full" != "true" && "$edge_count" -gt "$edge_limit" ]] && show_e=$edge_limit
  echo ""
  echo "edges[${show_e}]{from,to,kind}:"
  local e=0
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
    (( e >= show_e )) && break
    local from to kind
    IFS='|' read -r from to kind <<< "$line"
    echo "  ${from},${to},${kind}"
    (( e++ )) || true
  done < <(sort "$tmp_edges")

  rm -f "$tmp_nodes" "$tmp_edges" "$hubs_tmp"

  local hints=()
  (( node_count > node_limit || edge_count > edge_limit )) \
    && hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi graph --full\` to see all nodes and edges")
  hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi status\` for current state")
  help_hint "${hints[@]}"
}

cmd_commit() {
  local message="${1:-}"

  cd "$CHEZMOI_SRC" || die "chezmoi source dir not found: $CHEZMOI_SRC"

  local changes
  changes=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null || true)
  local untracked
  untracked=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null || true)

  if [[ -z "$changes" && -z "$untracked" ]]; then
    echo "commit: nothing to commit"
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi status\` for current state"
    return 0
  fi

  # Auto-generate message if not provided
  if [[ -z "$message" ]]; then
    local file_count
    file_count=$(echo -e "${changes}\n${untracked}" | grep -c '[^[:space:]]' || true)
    message="chore(dotfiles): update ${file_count} managed files"
  fi

  # Stage all changes
  git add -A 2>/dev/null
  git commit -m "$message" 2>/dev/null

  # Create branch and push
  local branch="update-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
  git checkout -b "$branch" 2>/dev/null
  git push -u origin "$branch" 2>/dev/null

  # Open PR
  local pr_url
  pr_url=$(gh pr create \
    --title "$message" \
    --body "Auto-generated by chezmoi-axi" \
    --base master 2>/dev/null || echo "")

  if [[ -n "$pr_url" ]]; then
    echo "commit: pushed and PR created"
    echo "pr: ${pr_url}"
  else
    echo "commit: pushed to branch ${branch}"
    echo "  Run \`gh pr create --base master\` to open a PR"
  fi

  # Return to master
  git checkout master 2>/dev/null
  git branch -d "$branch" 2>/dev/null || true

  help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi status\` to verify state"
}

cmd_help() {
  echo "chezmoi-axi — ${DESCRIPTION}"
  echo ""
  echo "Commands:"
  echo "  status       Show current state at a glance"
  echo "  list         List managed files [--changed] [--encrypted]"
  echo "  diff         Show diffs between source and installed"
  echo "  graph        Show relationship graph [--full] [--nodes N] [--edges N] [--output <file>]"
  echo "  add          Add file to source state [--encrypt]"
  echo "  re-add       Capture on-disk changes [--all]"
  echo "  apply        Apply source state to installed files"
  echo "  verify       Check files match source state"
  echo "  sync         Pull remote and apply [--preview] [--force] [--branch <name>]"
  echo "  commit       Commit, push, and open PR"
  echo "  help         Show this help"
  echo ""
  echo "Run \`chezmoi-axi <command> --help\` for command-specific help"
}

# --- Main ---

main() {
  local cmd="${1:-status}"
  shift || true

  case "$cmd" in
    status)   cmd_status "$@" ;;
    list|ls)  cmd_list "$@" ;;
    diff)     cmd_diff "$@" ;;
    graph)    cmd_graph "$@" ;;
    add)      cmd_add "$@" ;;
    re-add)   cmd_readd "$@" ;;
    apply)    cmd_apply "$@" ;;
    verify)   cmd_verify "$@" ;;
    sync)     cmd_sync "$@" ;;
    commit)   cmd_commit "$@" ;;
    help|-h|--help) cmd_help "$@" ;;
    *)
      echo "error: unknown command: $cmd"
      echo "help: valid commands: status, list, diff, graph, add, re-add, apply, verify, sync, commit, help"
      exit 2
      ;;
  esac
}

main "$@"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# chezmoi-axi — Agent-ergonomic chezmoi wrapper with TOON output
# Follows AXI 10 principles: token-efficient, minimal schemas, structured errors
set -euo pipefail

BIN_PATH="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
DESCRIPTION="Agent-ergonomic chezmoi wrapper for dotfiles management"
CHEZMOI_SRC="${HOME}/.local/share/chezmoi"

# --- Helpers ---

die() {
  echo "error: $1"
  [[ -n "${2:-}" ]] && echo "help: $2"
  exit 1
}

# Usage errors (unknown flag, missing required arg) exit 2 per AXI; runtime
# errors (file not found, drift, etc.) exit 1 via die().
usage_error() {
  echo "error: $1"
  [[ -n "${2:-}" ]] && echo "help: $2"
  exit 2
}

help_hint() {
  local hints=("$@")
  if [[ ${#hints[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "help[${#hints[@]}]:"
    for h in "${hints[@]}"; do
      echo "  $h"
    done
  fi
}

toon_list() {
  # $1 = header label, $2 = fields spec, then data lines
  local label="$1" fields="$2"
  shift 2
  echo "${label}[$#]{${fields}}:"
  for item in "$@"; do
    echo "  $item"
  done
}

# Map a target path (~/.ssh/config) to its source template entry if the target
# is managed by a template (dot_ssh/config.tmpl). Prints the source path and
# returns 0 if template-managed, 1 otherwise.
template_source_for() {
  local target="$1"
  local rel="${target#$HOME/}"
  local rel_dir rel_base mapped_dir=""
  rel_dir=$(dirname "$rel")
  rel_base=$(basename "$rel")

  # Map dir components: .ssh -> dot_ssh
  local p
  IFS='/' read -ra parts <<< "$rel_dir"
  for p in "${parts[@]}"; do
    [[ -z "$p" || "$p" == "." ]] && continue
    if [[ "$p" == .* ]]; then
      mapped_dir="${mapped_dir}/dot_${p#.}"
    else
      mapped_dir="${mapped_dir}/${p}"
    fi
  done

  # Map file component: .bashrc -> dot_bashrc
  local src_base="$rel_base"
  [[ "$src_base" == .* ]] && src_base="dot_${src_base#.}"

  local candidates=("${CHEZMOI_SRC}${mapped_dir}/${src_base}.tmpl")
  if [[ -n "$mapped_dir" ]]; then
    candidates+=(
      "${CHEZMOI_SRC}/private_${mapped_dir#/}/${src_base}.tmpl"
      "${CHEZMOI_SRC}/encrypted_${mapped_dir#/}/${src_base}.tmpl"
    )
  else
    candidates+=(
      "${CHEZMOI_SRC}/private_${src_base}.tmpl"
      "${CHEZMOI_SRC}/encrypted_${src_base}.tmpl"
    )
  fi

  local c
  for c in "${candidates[@]}"; do
    if [[ -f "$c" ]]; then
      echo "$c"
      return 0
    fi
  done
  return 1
}

# Re-add a single target with dry-run branch verdicts (Principle 5, 8).
# Returns: 0 = re-added, 2 = skipped (template-managed), 3 = in sync
readd_one() {
  local f="$1"
  f="${f/#\~/$HOME}"
  [[ "$f" != /* ]] && f="${HOME}/${f}"   # normalize relative paths (--all mode)

  if [[ ! -e "$f" ]]; then
    echo "error: file not found: ~${f#"$HOME"}"
    return 1
  fi

  local dry_out src
  # -n -v: dry-run with verbose diff on stderr — the only re-add feedback that
  # distinguishes "has changes" from "nothing to do". Without -v, --dry-run is
  # silent even for files with pending changes.
  dry_out=$(chezmoi re-add --dry-run --verbose "$f" 2>&1 || true)

  if [[ -n "$dry_out" ]]; then
    if chezmoi re-add "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "re-added: ~${f#"$HOME"}"
      return 0
    fi
    echo "error: failed to re-add ~${f#"$HOME"}"
    return 1
  fi

  # Empty dry-run: nothing would change. re-add silently skips template-managed
  # files (documented: "chezmoi will not overwrite templates"; exits 0, no
  # source change) — flag them instead of reporting success.
  if src=$(template_source_for "$f"); then
    echo "skipped: ~${f#"$HOME"} is template-managed (source ${src#$CHEZMOI_SRC/})"
    echo "  re-add cannot merge live-file edits into a template - edit the template directly"
    echo "  verify: chezmoi execute-template < ${src#$CHEZMOI_SRC/} | diff - ~${f#$HOME}"
    return 2
  fi

  echo "in sync: ~${f#"$HOME"} (no changes to capture)"
  return 3
}

# --- Commands ---

cmd_status() {
  local managed_count changed_count encrypted_count last_sync="never"

  managed_count=$(chezmoi managed 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)
  changed_count=$(chezmoi diff 2>/dev/null | grep '^diff --git' | wc -l || true)
  encrypted_count=$(find "$CHEZMOI_SRC" -name 'encrypted_*' -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)

  # Last sync: most recent commit in chezmoi source
  if [[ -d "$CHEZMOI_SRC/.git" ]]; then
    local last_epoch
    last_epoch=$(chezmoi git -- log -1 --format=%ct 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    if [[ "$last_epoch" -gt 0 ]]; then
      local now diff_s
      now=$(date +%s)
      diff_s=$(( now - last_epoch ))
      if (( diff_s < 3600 )); then
        last_sync="$(( diff_s / 60 ))m ago"
      elif (( diff_s < 86400 )); then
        last_sync="$(( diff_s / 3600 ))h ago"
      else
        last_sync="$(( diff_s / 86400 ))d ago"
      fi
    fi
  fi

  echo "chezmoi:"
  local bin_display="$BIN_PATH"
  [[ "$bin_display" == "$HOME"* ]] && bin_display="~${bin_display#"$HOME"}"
  echo "  bin: ${bin_display}"
  echo "  description: ${DESCRIPTION}"
  echo "  managed: ${managed_count}"
  echo "  changed: ${changed_count}"
  echo "  encrypted: ${encrypted_count}"
  echo "  last_sync: ${last_sync}"

  local hints=()
  if (( changed_count > 0 )); then
    hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi list --changed\` to see pending changes")
    hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi diff\` to review diffs")
  fi
  hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi list\` to see all managed files")
  help_hint "${hints[@]}"
}

cmd_list() {
  local filter="all" full=false
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --changed)  filter="changed"; shift ;;
      --encrypted) filter="encrypted"; shift ;;
      --full)     full=true; shift ;;
      -h|--help)
        echo "Usage: chezmoi-axi list [--changed] [--encrypted] [--full]"
        echo "  --changed    Show only files with pending diffs"
        echo "  --encrypted  Show only encrypted files"
        echo "  --full       Show every file (bypass the 50-row cap)"
        exit 0 ;;
      *) usage_error "unknown flag: $1" "chezmoi-axi list [--changed] [--encrypted] [--full]" ;;
    esac
  done

  local files=()
  case "$filter" in
    changed)
      while IFS= read -r line; do
        local f
        f=$(echo "$line" | sed 's|^diff --git a/.* b/||')
        files+=("$f")
      done < <(chezmoi diff 2>/dev/null | grep '^diff --git')
      ;;
    encrypted)
      while IFS= read -r f; do
        local target
        target=$(basename "$f" | sed 's/^encrypted_//' | sed 's/\.age$//' | sed 's/^private_//')
        # Map source name back to target path
        local relpath="${f#$CHEZMOI_SRC/}"
        relpath=$(echo "$relpath" | sed 's|^dot_|.|' | sed 's|^encrypted_||' | sed 's|\.age$||' | sed 's|^private_|.|')
        files+=("~/${relpath}")
      done < <(find "$CHEZMOI_SRC" -name 'encrypted_*' -type f 2>/dev/null)
      ;;
    all)
      while IFS= read -r f; do
        local relpath="${f#$CHEZMOI_SRC/}"
        relpath=$(echo "$relpath" | sed 's|^dot_|.|' )
        files+=("~/${relpath}")
      done < <(chezmoi managed 2>/dev/null)
      ;;
  esac

  local count=${#files[@]}
  local total
  total=$(chezmoi managed 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)

  if (( count == 0 )); then
    echo "files: 0 ${filter} files found"
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi list\` to see all managed files"
    return 0
  fi

  # Truncate if >50 files (Principle 3); --full bypasses the cap (escape hatch)
  local display_files=("${files[@]}")
  local truncated=false
  if [[ "$full" != "true" && "$count" -gt 50 ]]; then
    display_files=("${files[@]:0:50}")
    truncated=true
  fi

  echo "files[${count}]{path,type,encrypted}:"
  for f in "${display_files[@]}"; do
    local enc="no"
    [[ "$f" == *"secret"* || "$f" == *"key"* || "$f" == *".env"* ]] && enc="maybe"
    # Determine type from extension
    local ext="${f##*.}"
    local ftype="file"
    [[ "$ext" == "sh" || "$ext" == "bash" || "$ext" == "zsh" ]] && ftype="shell"
    [[ "$ext" == "json" ]] && ftype="json"
    [[ "$ext" == "yaml" || "$ext" == "yml" ]] && ftype="yaml"
    [[ "$ext" == "toml" ]] && ftype="toml"
    [[ "$ext" == "conf" || "$ext" == "cfg" ]] && ftype="config"
    [[ "$ext" == "age" ]] && ftype="encrypted"
    echo "  ${f},${ftype},${enc}"
  done

  if (( count != total )); then
    echo "count: ${count} of ${total} total"
  fi
  if [[ "$truncated" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "  ... (${count} total, showing first 50)"
    echo "help[1]: Run \`chezmoi-axi list --full\` for all ${count} files"
  fi

  local hints=()
  hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi add <file>\` to track a new file")
  [[ "$filter" == "all" ]] && hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi diff\` to review changes")
  help_hint "${hints[@]}"
}

cmd_diff() {
  local target="${1:-}"
  local raw_diff

  if [[ -n "$target" ]]; then
    # Diff specific file
    local src_path
    src_path=$(chezmoi managed --include files 2>/dev/null | grep -i "$(basename "$target")" | head -1 || true)
    if [[ -z "$src_path" ]]; then
      die "file not managed by chezmoi: $target" "Run \`chezmoi-axi add $target\` to start tracking it"
    fi
    raw_diff=$(chezmoi diff -- "$target" 2>/dev/null || true)
  else
    raw_diff=$(chezmoi diff 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi

  if [[ -z "$raw_diff" ]]; then
    echo "diffs: 0 files with changes"
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi list\` to see all managed files"
    return 0
  fi

  # Parse diff into TOON summary
  local files_changed=0
  local total_add=0
  local total_del=0
  echo "diffs:"
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    if [[ "$line" == diff\ --git* ]]; then
      (( files_changed++ )) || true
      local path
      path=$(echo "$line" | sed 's|^diff --git a/.* b/||')
      echo "  ${path}"
    elif [[ "$line" == @@* ]]; then
      local stats
      stats=$(echo "$line" | grep -oP '[+-]\d+' | paste -sd' ' || true)
      local adds dels
      adds=$(echo "$stats" | grep -oP '\+\d+' | tr -d '+' | paste -sd'+' | bc 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
      dels=$(echo "$stats" | grep -oP '-\d+' | tr -d '-' | paste -sd'+' | bc 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
      (( total_add += adds )) || true
      (( total_del += dels )) || true
    fi
  done <<< "$raw_diff"

  echo "summary: ${files_changed} files, +${total_add} -${total_del}"

  local hints=()
  (( files_changed > 0 )) && hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi apply\` to apply these changes")
  hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi apply --preview\` to dry-run first")
  help_hint "${hints[@]}"
}

cmd_add() {
  local encrypt=false
  local files=()

  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --encrypt|-e) encrypt=true; shift ;;
      -h|--help)
        echo "Usage: chezmoi-axi add [--encrypt] <file>..."
        echo "  --encrypt  Encrypt the file with age before adding"
        exit 0 ;;
      -*) usage_error "unknown flag: $1" "chezmoi-axi add [--encrypt] <file>..." ;;
      *)  files+=("$1"); shift ;;
    esac
  done

  [[ ${#files[@]} -eq 0 ]] && usage_error "no files specified" "chezmoi-axi add [--encrypt] <file>..."

  local added=0 skipped=0
  for f in "${files[@]}"; do
    # Expand ~ if present
    f="${f/#\~/$HOME}"
    if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
      echo "error: file not found: $f"
      (( skipped++ )) || true
      continue
    fi

    local args=()
    [[ "$encrypt" == "true" ]] && args+=(--encrypt)

    if chezmoi add "${args[@]}" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "added: ~${f#"$HOME"}"
      (( added++ )) || true
    else
      # Check if already managed
      if chezmoi managed 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$(basename "$f")"; then
        echo "already managed: ~${f#"$HOME"}"
        (( skipped++ )) || true
      else
        echo "error: failed to add ~${f#"$HOME"}"
        (( skipped++ )) || true
      fi
    fi
  done

  echo "summary: ${added} added, ${skipped} skipped"
  local hints=()
  (( added > 0 )) && hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi diff\` to verify no drift")
  (( added > 0 )) && hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi commit\` to commit and push")
  (( added == 0 )) && hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi list\` to see what's managed")
  help_hint "${hints[@]}"
}

cmd_readd() {
  local add_all=false
  local files=()

  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --all|-a) add_all=true; shift ;;
      -h|--help)
        echo "Usage: chezmoi-axi re-add [--all] [file]..."
        echo "  --all  Re-add all changed files"
        exit 0 ;;
      -*) usage_error "unknown flag: $1" "chezmoi-axi re-add [--all] [file]..." ;;
      *)  files+=("$1"); shift ;;
    esac
  done

  if [[ "$add_all" == "true" ]]; then
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      local f
      f=$(echo "$line" | sed 's|^diff --git a/.* b/||')
      files+=("$f")
    done < <(chezmoi diff 2>/dev/null | grep '^diff --git')
  fi

  if [[ ${#files[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "re-added: 0 files (no changes detected)"
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi list\` to see all managed files"
    return 0
  fi

  local readded=0 skipped=0 insync=0 rc=0
  for f in "${files[@]}"; do
    readd_one "$f" || rc=$?
    if   [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then (( readded++ )) || true
    elif [[ $rc -eq 2 ]]; then (( skipped++ )) || true
    elif [[ $rc -eq 3 ]]; then (( insync++ )) || true
    fi
    rc=0
  done

  echo "summary: ${readded} re-added, ${skipped} skipped (template-managed), ${insync} in sync"

  local hints=()
  (( skipped > 0 )) && hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi diff\` to review template drift")
  (( readded > 0 )) && hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi diff\` to verify clean state")
  (( readded > 0 )) && hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi commit\` to commit and push")
  help_hint "${hints[@]}"
}

cmd_apply() {
  local preview=false
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --preview|-n) preview=true; shift ;;
      -h|--help)
        echo "Usage: chezmoi-axi apply [--preview]"
        echo "  --preview  Show what would change without applying"
        exit 0 ;;
      *) usage_error "unknown flag: $1" "chezmoi-axi apply [--preview]" ;;
    esac
  done

  if [[ "$preview" == "true" ]]; then
    cmd_diff
    return
  fi

  local output
  if output=$(chezmoi apply 2>&1); then
    echo "applied: changes applied successfully"
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi verify\` to confirm state"
  else
    echo "error: chezmoi apply failed"
    echo "$output" | head -5
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi diff\` to review what failed"
    return 1
  fi
}

cmd_verify() {
  local drift_count=0
  local output

  # chezmoi verify exits 1 for untracked files too; use diff for actual drift detection
  output=$(chezmoi verify 2>&1 || true)
  drift_count=$(echo "$output" | grep -c 'has changed' || true)

  # Also check if verify failed but produced no "has changed" lines (untracked files)
  if (( drift_count > 0 )); then
    echo "verify: ${drift_count} files have drifted from source state"
    echo "$output" | head -10
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi diff\` to see what changed" \
              "Run \`chezmoi-axi re-add --all\` to capture changes"
    return 1
  fi

  # Check for untracked files (files on disk not in source state)
  local untracked
  untracked=$(chezmoi managed --include files 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)
  local target_files
  target_files=$(find "${HOME}" -maxdepth 1 -name '.*' -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)

  echo "verify: all tracked files match source state"
  help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi list\` to see managed files" \
            "Run \`chezmoi-axi diff\` to check for pending changes"
  return 0
}

cmd_sync() {
  # Keep the periodic sync log bounded: rotate once past the cap.
  # Applies to the canonical cron log only; other redirections stay untouched.
  local sync_log="${CHEZMOI_SRC}/.chezmoi-sync.log"
  local max_bytes="${CHEZMOI_SYNC_LOG_MAX:-524288}"
  if [[ -f "$sync_log" && "$(wc -c <"$sync_log")" -ge "$max_bytes" ]]; then
    cp "$sync_log" "$sync_log.old" && : > "$sync_log"
  fi

  echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')] chezmoi-axi sync start"
  local rc=0
  _sync_run "$@" || rc=$?
  echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')] chezmoi-axi sync end rc=$rc"
  return "$rc"
}

_sync_run() {
  local preview=false force=false branch_arg=""
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --preview|-n) preview=true; shift ;;
      --force|-f)   force=true; shift ;;
      --branch)
        if [[ $# -lt 2 || -z "${2:-}" || "${2:-}" == -* ]]; then
          usage_error "--branch requires a branch name" "chezmoi-axi sync [--preview] [--force] [--branch <name>]"
        fi
        branch_arg="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      -h|--help)
        echo "Usage: chezmoi-axi sync [--preview] [--force] [--branch <name>]"
        echo "  --preview        Fetch remote and show diff without applying"
        echo "  --force          Apply without prompting (resolves local drift, for cron)"
        echo "  --branch <name>  Sync a non-default branch explicitly (escape hatch)"
        echo "Stamps start/end (with exit code) around every sync; rotates"
        echo "  ~/.local/share/chezmoi/.chezmoi-sync.log to .old at 512 KiB"
        echo "  (CHEZMOI_SYNC_LOG_MAX bytes, for the crontab redirect)"
        return 0 ;;
      *) usage_error "unknown flag: $1" "chezmoi-axi sync [--preview] [--force] [--branch <name>]" ;;
    esac
  done

  # Force the passphrase-free deploy key for all git SSH operations so
  # sync never prompts — safe for cron, agents, and headless contexts.
  export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i ~/.ssh/chezmoi-deploy-key -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes"

  echo "syncing: fetching remote changes..."
  chezmoi git -- fetch origin 2>/dev/null || true

  # Branch guard: never auto-switch away from a branch carrying live work.
  local current_branch default_branch
  current_branch=$(chezmoi git -- branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || true)
  default_branch=$(chezmoi git -- rev-parse --abbrev-ref origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's|^origin/||' || true)
  [[ -z "$default_branch" ]] && default_branch="master"

  if [[ -n "$branch_arg" ]]; then
    # Escape hatch: caller explicitly wants this branch synced.
    if [[ "$current_branch" != "$branch_arg" ]]; then
      if ! chezmoi git -- checkout "$branch_arg" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        die "cannot check out branch: ${branch_arg}" "Verify the branch exists: \`chezmoi git -- branch --list\`"
      fi
      echo "checked out: ${branch_arg}"
    fi
  elif [[ -n "$current_branch" && "$current_branch" != "$default_branch" ]]; then
    # On a non-default branch: fail if there is live work, never auto-switch over it.
    local dirty=false merged=false unpushed=0
    [[ -n "$(chezmoi git -- status --porcelain 2>/dev/null || true)" ]] && dirty=true
    # Fully merged means every commit's work is already on origin/<default>:
    # either HEAD itself is an ancestor, or the only local commits are merge
    # commits (e.g. a local merge of origin/<default> after a PR merge).
    if chezmoi git -- merge-base --is-ancestor "HEAD" "origin/${default_branch}" 2>/dev/null; then
      merged=true
    else
      unpushed=$({ chezmoi git -- log --oneline --no-merges "origin/${default_branch}..HEAD" 2>/dev/null || true; } | wc -l)
    fi
    if [[ "$dirty" == "true" || ("$merged" != "true" && "$unpushed" -gt 0) ]]; then
      echo "error: sync blocked: branch '${current_branch}' has live work (uncommitted: ${dirty}, unpushed: ${unpushed})"
      echo "help[2]:"
      echo "  recover: commit or push on '${current_branch}', then rerun \`chezmoi-axi sync\`"
      echo "  deliberate: run \`chezmoi-axi sync --branch ${current_branch}\` to sync this branch anyway"
      return 1
    fi
    # Clean and fully merged: safe to auto-checkout the default branch.
    if ! chezmoi git -- checkout "$default_branch" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      die "cannot check out default branch: ${default_branch}" "Check \`chezmoi git -- status\` in ${CHEZMOI_SRC}"
    fi
    echo "checked out: ${default_branch} (branch '${current_branch}' was clean and merged)"
  fi

  local remote_branch="$default_branch"
  [[ -n "$branch_arg" ]] && remote_branch="$branch_arg"

  local remote_commits
  remote_commits=$({ chezmoi git -- log --oneline "HEAD..origin/${remote_branch}" 2>/dev/null || true; } | wc -l)

  if [[ "$remote_commits" -eq 0 && "$force" != "true" ]]; then
    echo "sync: already up to date"
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi status\` for current state"
    return 0
  fi

  if [[ "$remote_commits" -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "found: ${remote_commits} new commits on remote"
  else
    echo "sync: no new commits, applying to resolve local drift"
  fi

  if [[ "$preview" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "diffs:"
    chezmoi git -- diff --stat "HEAD" "origin/${remote_branch}" 2>/dev/null || true
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi sync\` to apply these changes"
    return 0
  fi

  local update_args=()
  [[ "$force" == "true" ]] && update_args+=(--force)

  local output
  if output=$(chezmoi update "${update_args[@]}" 2>&1); then
    echo "sync: pulled and applied${force:+ (force)}"
  else
    echo "error: chezmoi update failed"
    echo "$output" | head -10
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi diff\` to review what failed"
    return 1
  fi
  help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi verify\` to confirm state"
}

src_to_target() {
  local src_rel="$1" path="$1"
  local was_dot=false was_private=false
  [[ "$src_rel" == dot_* ]] && was_dot=true
  [[ "$src_rel" == private_* ]] && was_private=true
  path="${path#dot_}"
  path="${path#private_}"
  path="${path#executable_}"
  path="${path#encrypted_}"
  path="${path#symlink_}"
  path="${path#run_once_}"
  path="${path#run_onchange_}"
  path="${path#run_onchange_after_}"
  path="${path#run_onchange_before_}"
  if [[ "$was_dot" == "true" ]]; then
    path=".${path}"
  elif [[ "$was_private" == "true" && "$src_rel" == private_dot_* ]]; then
    path=".${path}"
  fi
  path="${path%.tmpl}"
  path="${path%.age}"
  echo "~/${path}"
}

classify_group() {
  local base="$1"
  case "$base" in
    executable_*)  echo "Scripts" ;;
    symlink_*)     echo "Symlinks" ;;
    encrypted_*)   echo "Encrypted" ;;
    *.service.tmpl|*.service) echo "Systemd Units" ;;
    *.timer)       echo "Timers" ;;
    run_once_*)    echo "Run-Once Scripts" ;;
    run_onchange_*) echo "Run-Onchange Scripts" ;;
    *.tmpl)        echo "Templates" ;;
    dot_*)         echo "Config Files" ;;
    private_*)     echo "Private Files" ;;
    *)             echo "Other Files" ;;
  esac
}

classify_label() {
  local kind="$1"
  case "$kind" in
    script)      echo "Shell script" ;;
    symlink)     echo "Symlink" ;;
    encrypted)   echo "Age-encrypted file" ;;
    svc)         echo "Systemd service unit" ;;
    timer)       echo "Systemd timer unit" ;;
    run-once)    echo "Run-once script" ;;
    run-onchange) echo "Run-onchange script" ;;
    template)    echo "Chezmoi template" ;;
    config)      echo "Config file" ;;
    private)     echo "Private file" ;;
    *)           echo "File" ;;
  esac
}

graph_write_latmd() {
  local nodes_file="$1" edges_file="$2" node_count="$3" edge_count="$4" out_path="$5"

  local hubs_tmp
  hubs_tmp=$(mktemp)
  cut -d'|' -f2 "$edges_file" > "$hubs_tmp" || true
  local hub_lines
  hub_lines=$(sort "$hubs_tmp" 2>/dev/null | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10 || true)

  local edge_kinds
  edge_kinds=$(cut -d'|' -f3 "$edges_file" 2>/dev/null | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn || true)

  local out_dir
  out_dir=$(dirname "$out_path")
  mkdir -p "$out_dir"

  {
    echo "graph:"
    echo "  generated-by: chezmoi-axi graph --output"
    echo "  generated-at: $(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
    echo "  nodes: ${node_count}"
    echo "  edges: ${edge_count}"

    echo ""
    echo "edge_kinds:"
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
      echo "  ${line}"
    done <<< "$edge_kinds"

    echo ""
    echo "hubs[10]{node,edges_in}:"
    if [[ -n "$hub_lines" ]]; then
      while IFS= read -r line; do
        [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
        local count node
        count=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $1}')
        node=$(echo "$line" | awk '{$1=""; print}' | sed 's/^ //')
        echo "  ${node},${count}"
      done <<< "$hub_lines"
    else
      echo "  (none)"
    fi

    echo ""
    echo "index[${node_count}]{group,node,target}:"
    local current_group=""
    while IFS= read -r rel; do
      [[ -z "$rel" ]] && continue
      local base group target_path
      base=$(basename "$rel")
      group=$(classify_group "$base")
      target_path=$(src_to_target "$rel")
      echo "  ${group},${rel},${target_path}"
    done < <(sort "$nodes_file")

    echo ""
    echo "nodes[${node_count}]{source,type,target,outgoing,incoming}:"
    while IFS= read -r rel; do
      [[ -z "$rel" ]] && continue
      local base kind kind_label target_path
      base=$(basename "$rel")
      kind=$(classify "$base")
      kind_label=$(classify_label "$kind")
      target_path=$(src_to_target "$rel")

      local out_edges in_edges
      out_edges=$(grep "^${rel}|" "$edges_file" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)
      in_edges=$(grep "|${rel}|" "$edges_file" 2>/dev/null | wc -l || true)

      echo "  ${rel},${kind},${target_path},${out_edges},${in_edges}"

      local edges_for_node
      edges_for_node=$(grep "^${rel}|" "$edges_file" 2>/dev/null | sort || true)
      if [[ -n "$edges_for_node" ]]; then
        echo "  outgoing:"
        while IFS='|' read -r from to ekind; do
          [[ -z "$ekind" ]] && continue
          echo "    ${ekind},${to}"
        done <<< "$edges_for_node"
      fi

      local incoming
      incoming=$(grep "|${rel}|" "$edges_file" 2>/dev/null | sort || true)
      if [[ -n "$incoming" ]]; then
        echo "  incoming:"
        while IFS='|' read -r ifrom ito ikind; do
          [[ -z "$ikind" ]] && continue
          echo "    ${ikind},${ifrom}"
        done <<< "$incoming"
      fi
    done < <(sort "$nodes_file")

  } > "$out_path"

  rm -f "$hubs_tmp"
}

cmd_graph() {
  local node_limit=50 edge_limit=100 full=false output=""
  while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
      --full)   full=true; shift ;;
      --nodes)  node_limit="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --edges)  edge_limit="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      --output) output="$2"; shift 2 ;;
      -h|--help)
        echo "Usage: chezmoi-axi graph [--full] [--nodes N] [--edges N] [--output <file>]"
        echo "  --full       Show all nodes and edges (bypass caps)"
        echo "  --nodes N    Max nodes to display (default 50)"
        echo "  --edges N    Max edges to display (default 100)"
        echo "  --output F   Write graph as lat.md-style markdown to file (implies --full)"
        echo ""
        echo "Parses the chezmoi source tree into a relationship graph:"
        echo "  source->target   filename conventions (dot_ executable_ symlink_ .tmpl)"
        echo "  template->var    {{ .chezmoi.* }} and {{ .custom }} references"
        echo "  unit->exec       ExecStart= in systemd units"
        echo "  unit->dep        After= Requires= Wants= in systemd units"
        echo "  timer->unit      Unit= in timer files (implicit by name)"
        echo "  script->source   source/. commands in shell scripts"
        echo "  script->bin      command calls via \$HOME/.local/bin references"
        echo "  symlink->target  symlink_ prefix resolution"
        echo "  var-def          variable definitions (export VAR=, Environment=VAR=)"
        echo "  var-ref          variable references (\$VAR, \${VAR})"
        echo "  md-wikilink     [[wikilink]] references in markdown files"
        echo "  md-link          [text](relative-path) links in markdown files"
        echo ""
        echo "With --output, writes a lat.md-convention markdown file:"
        echo "  - Index with wiki links at the top"
        echo "  - Sections grouped by domain concept"
        echo "  - Each node has a heading, leading paragraph, and edge listings"
        echo "  - Cross-references use [[wiki-link]] syntax"
        exit 0 ;;
      --output=*) output="${1#--output=}"; shift ;;
      -*) usage_error "unknown flag: $1" "chezmoi-axi graph [--full] [--nodes N] [--edges N] [--output <file>]" ;;
      *)  usage_error "unexpected argument: $1" "chezmoi-axi graph [--full] [--nodes N] [--edges N] [--output <file>]" ;;
    esac
  done

  [[ -n "$output" ]] && full=true

  if ! command -v rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    die "ripgrep (rg) is required but not found on PATH" "Install ripgrep: https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep"
  fi

  [[ ! -d "$CHEZMOI_SRC" ]] && die "chezmoi source dir not found: $CHEZMOI_SRC" "Run \`chezmoi init\` first"

  local tmp_nodes tmp_edges
  tmp_nodes=$(mktemp)
  tmp_edges=$(mktemp)

  : > "$tmp_nodes"
  : > "$tmp_edges"

  add_node() {
    local rel="$1"
    grep -qxF "$rel" "$tmp_nodes" 2>/dev/null && return 0
    echo "$rel" >> "$tmp_nodes"
  }

  add_edge() {
    local from="$1" to="$2" kind="$3"
    local line="${from}|${to}|${kind}"
    grep -qxF "$line" "$tmp_edges" 2>/dev/null && return 0
    echo "$line" >> "$tmp_edges"
  }

  classify() {
    local base="$1"
    case "$base" in
      executable_*)  echo "script" ;;
      symlink_*)     echo "symlink" ;;
      encrypted_*)   echo "encrypted" ;;
      *.service.tmpl) echo "svc" ;;
      *.service)     echo "svc" ;;
      *.timer)       echo "timer" ;;
      run_once_*)    echo "run-once" ;;
      run_onchange_*) echo "run-onchange" ;;
      *.tmpl)        echo "template" ;;
      dot_*)         echo "config" ;;
      private_*)     echo "private" ;;
      *)             echo "file" ;;
    esac
  }

  while IFS= read -r -d '' src; do
    local base
    base=$(basename "$src")
    [[ "$base" == .* ]] && continue
    [[ "$base" == *.bak ]] && continue
    local rel="${src#"$CHEZMOI_SRC/"}"
    add_node "$rel"
  done < <(find "$CHEZMOI_SRC" -type f -not -path '*/.git/*' -print0 | sort -z)

  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    [[ -z "$rel" ]] && continue
    local base
    base=$(basename "$rel")
    local target_path
    target_path=$(src_to_target "$rel")

    case "$base" in
      dot_*|executable_*|encrypted_*|private_*|run_once_*|run_onchange_*)
        add_edge "$rel" "$target_path" "source->target"
        ;;
      symlink_*)
        local link_target
        link_target=$(readlink "${CHEZMOI_SRC}/${rel}" 2>/dev/null || true)
        [[ -n "$link_target" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$link_target" "symlink->target"
        add_edge "$rel" "$target_path" "source->target"
        ;;
    esac
  done < "$tmp_nodes"

  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    [[ -z "$rel" ]] && continue
    local full_path="${CHEZMOI_SRC}/${rel}"
    local base
    base=$(basename "$rel")

    if [[ "$base" == *.tmpl ]]; then
      local vars
      vars=$(rg -o '\{\{\s*\.([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_.]*)' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null \
        | sed 's/{{ *\.//' | sort -u || true)
      local v
      for v in $vars; do
        add_edge "$rel" "{{ .${v} }}" "template->var"
      done
    fi

    case "$base" in
      *.service|*.service.tmpl)
        local exec_lines deps wanted_by
        exec_lines=$(rg -o 'ExecStart[^\n]*' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        while IFS= read -r el; do
          [[ -z "$el" ]] && continue
          local cmd
          cmd=$(echo "$el" \
            | sed 's/^ExecStart[= ]*//' \
            | sed 's/%h/$HOME/g' \
            | sed 's/{{ *\.chezmoi\.homeDir *}}/$HOME/g')
          local bin_name
          bin_name=$(echo "$cmd" | awk '{print $1}' | sed 's|.*/||')
          [[ -n "$bin_name" && "$bin_name" != *"="{{* ]] \
            && add_edge "$rel" "$bin_name" "unit->exec"
        done <<< "$exec_lines"

        deps=$(rg -o '(?:After|Requires|Wants)=[^\n]*' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        while IFS= read -r dl; do
          [[ -z "$dl" ]] && continue
          local dep_name
          dep_name=$(echo "$dl" | sed 's/^\(After\|Requires\|Wants\)=//' | cut -d' ' -f1)
          [[ -n "$dep_name" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$dep_name" "unit->dep"
        done <<< "$deps"

        wanted_by=$(rg -o 'WantedBy=[^\n]*' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        while IFS= read -r wb; do
          [[ -z "$wb" ]] && continue
          local target
          target=$(echo "$wb" | sed 's/^WantedBy=//' | cut -d' ' -f1)
          [[ -n "$target" ]] && add_edge "$target" "$rel" "target->unit"
        done <<< "$wanted_by"
        ;;
      *.timer)
        local unit_ref
        unit_ref=$(rg -o 'Unit=[^\n]*' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        if [[ -n "$unit_ref" ]]; then
          local timer_target
          timer_target=$(echo "$unit_ref" | sed 's/^Unit=//' | cut -d' ' -f1)
          [[ -n "$timer_target" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$timer_target" "timer->unit"
        else
          local implied
          implied=$(echo "$rel" | sed 's/\.timer$//')
          add_edge "$rel" "${implied}.service" "timer->unit"
        fi
        ;;
    esac

    case "$base" in
      executable_*|run_once_*|run_onchange_*|dot_bashrc|dot_zshrc|dot_profile)
        local source_refs bin_refs
        source_refs=$(rg -o '(?:source|\.)\s+[$~/][^ "'\''
;&|]+' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        while IFS= read -r s; do
          [[ -z "$s" ]] && continue
          s=$(echo "$s" | sed 's/^[a-z]*[[:space:]]*//' | sed 's/\$HOME/~/g' | sed 's/%h/~/g')
          add_edge "$rel" "$s" "script->source"
        done <<< "$source_refs"

        bin_refs=$(rg -o '\$HOME/\.local/bin/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        local b
        for b in $(echo "$bin_refs" | sed 's|.*bin/||' | sort -u); do
          [[ -n "$b" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$b" "script->bin"
        done
        ;;
    esac

    # --- Variable definitions: export VAR=, VAR= (assignments), Environment=VAR= in systemd ---
    case "$base" in
      dot_bashrc|dot_zshrc|dot_zshenv.tmpl|dot_zshenv|dot_profile|\
      executable_*|run_once_*|run_onchange_*)
        local var_defs
        var_defs=$(rg -o '(?:^|;|\s)(?:export\s+)?[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*=' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null \
          | sed 's/^.*export[[:space:]]*//' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | sed 's/=.*//' | sort -u || true)
        local vd
        for vd in $var_defs; do
          [[ -n "$vd" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$vd" "var-def"
        done
        ;;
      *.service|*.service.tmpl)
        local env_defs
        env_defs=$(rg -o 'Environment(?:=|[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*=)[^\n]*' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        while IFS= read -r ed; do
          [[ -z "$ed" ]] && continue
          local env_name
          env_name=$(echo "$ed" | sed 's/^Environment[= ]*//' | sed 's/=.*//' | cut -d' ' -f1)
          [[ -n "$env_name" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$env_name" "var-def"
        done <<< "$env_defs"
        ;;
    esac

    # --- Variable references: $VAR and ${VAR} ---
    case "$base" in
      dot_bashrc|dot_zshrc|dot_zshenv.tmpl|dot_zshenv|dot_profile|\
      executable_*|run_once_*|run_onchange_*)
        local var_refs
        var_refs=$(rg -o '\$\{[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*\}|\$[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null \
          | sed 's/^\${\|^\$//' | sed 's/}$//' | sort -u || true)
        local vr
        for vr in $var_refs; do
          [[ -n "$vr" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$vr" "var-ref"
        done
        ;;
    esac

    # --- Markdown cross-references: [[wikilinks]] and [text](relative-path) ---
    case "$base" in
      *.md)
        local wiki_refs
        wiki_refs=$(rg -o '\[\[([^\]|#]+)(?:#[^\]]+)?\]\]' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null \
          | sed 's/^\[\[//' | sed 's/\]\]$//' | sed 's/#.*//' | sort -u || true)
        local wr
        for wr in $wiki_refs; do
          [[ -n "$wr" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$wr" "md-wikilink"
        done

        local md_links
        md_links=$(rg -o '\[[^\]]+\]\((?!https?://)([^)]+)\)' "$full_path" 2>/dev/null \
          | sed 's/.*(\(.*\))/\1/' | sort -u || true)
        local ml
        for ml in $md_links; do
          [[ -n "$ml" ]] && add_edge "$rel" "$ml" "md-link"
        done
        ;;
    esac
  done < "$tmp_nodes"

  local node_count edge_count
  node_count=$(wc -l < "$tmp_nodes")
  edge_count=$(wc -l < "$tmp_edges")

  if (( node_count == 0 )); then
    rm -f "$tmp_nodes" "$tmp_edges"
    echo "graph: 0 nodes found in source tree"
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi status\` to check source state"
    return 0
  fi

  if [[ -n "$output" ]]; then
    graph_write_latmd "$tmp_nodes" "$tmp_edges" "$node_count" "$edge_count" "$output"
    rm -f "$tmp_nodes" "$tmp_edges"
    echo "graph: wrote ${node_count} nodes, ${edge_count} edges to ${output}"
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi graph\` for TOON output to stdout"
    return 0
  fi

  local hubs_tmp
  hubs_tmp=$(mktemp)

  cut -d'|' -f2 "$tmp_edges" > "$hubs_tmp"
  local hub_lines
  hub_lines=$(sort "$hubs_tmp" | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10)

  local edge_kinds
  edge_kinds=$(cut -d'|' -f3 "$tmp_edges" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn)

  if [[ "$full" != "true" ]]; then
    local disp_n="$node_count" disp_e="$edge_count"
    if (( node_count > node_limit )); then disp_n="$node_limit"; fi
    if (( edge_count > edge_limit )); then disp_e="$edge_limit"; fi

    echo "graph:"
    if (( node_count > node_limit )); then
      echo "  nodes: ${disp_n} of ${node_count} total"
    else
      echo "  nodes: ${disp_n}"
    fi
    if (( edge_count > edge_limit )); then
      echo "  edges: ${disp_e} of ${edge_count} total"
    else
      echo "  edges: ${disp_e}"
    fi
  else
    echo "graph:"
    echo "  nodes: ${node_count}"
    echo "  edges: ${edge_count}"
  fi

  echo ""
  echo "edge_kinds:"
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
    echo "  $line"
  done <<< "$edge_kinds"

  if [[ -n "$hub_lines" ]]; then
    echo ""
    echo "hubs[10]{node,edges_in}:"
    while IFS= read -r line; do
      [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
      local count node
      count=$(echo "$line" | awk '{print $1}')
      node=$(echo "$line" | awk '{$1=""; print}' | sed 's/^ //')
      echo "  ${node},${count}"
    done <<< "$hub_lines"
  fi

  local show_n=$node_count
  [[ "$full" != "true" && "$node_count" -gt "$node_limit" ]] && show_n=$node_limit
  echo ""
  echo "nodes[${show_n}]{source,type}:"
  local n=0
  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    [[ -z "$rel" ]] && continue
    (( n >= show_n )) && break
    echo "  ${rel},$(classify "$(basename "$rel")")"
    (( n++ )) || true
  done < <(sort "$tmp_nodes")

  local show_e=$edge_count
  [[ "$full" != "true" && "$edge_count" -gt "$edge_limit" ]] && show_e=$edge_limit
  echo ""
  echo "edges[${show_e}]{from,to,kind}:"
  local e=0
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [[ -z "$line" ]] && continue
    (( e >= show_e )) && break
    local from to kind
    IFS='|' read -r from to kind <<< "$line"
    echo "  ${from},${to},${kind}"
    (( e++ )) || true
  done < <(sort "$tmp_edges")

  rm -f "$tmp_nodes" "$tmp_edges" "$hubs_tmp"

  local hints=()
  (( node_count > node_limit || edge_count > edge_limit )) \
    && hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi graph --full\` to see all nodes and edges")
  hints+=("Run \`chezmoi-axi status\` for current state")
  help_hint "${hints[@]}"
}

cmd_commit() {
  local message="${1:-}"

  cd "$CHEZMOI_SRC" || die "chezmoi source dir not found: $CHEZMOI_SRC"

  local changes
  changes=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null || true)
  local untracked
  untracked=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null || true)

  if [[ -z "$changes" && -z "$untracked" ]]; then
    echo "commit: nothing to commit"
    help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi status\` for current state"
    return 0
  fi

  # Auto-generate message if not provided
  if [[ -z "$message" ]]; then
    local file_count
    file_count=$(echo -e "${changes}\n${untracked}" | grep -c '[^[:space:]]' || true)
    message="chore(dotfiles): update ${file_count} managed files"
  fi

  # Stage all changes
  git add -A 2>/dev/null
  git commit -m "$message" 2>/dev/null

  # Create branch and push
  local branch="update-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
  git checkout -b "$branch" 2>/dev/null
  git push -u origin "$branch" 2>/dev/null

  # Open PR
  local pr_url
  pr_url=$(gh pr create \
    --title "$message" \
    --body "Auto-generated by chezmoi-axi" \
    --base master 2>/dev/null || echo "")

  if [[ -n "$pr_url" ]]; then
    echo "commit: pushed and PR created"
    echo "pr: ${pr_url}"
  else
    echo "commit: pushed to branch ${branch}"
    echo "  Run \`gh pr create --base master\` to open a PR"
  fi

  # Return to master
  git checkout master 2>/dev/null
  git branch -d "$branch" 2>/dev/null || true

  help_hint "Run \`chezmoi-axi status\` to verify state"
}

cmd_help() {
  echo "chezmoi-axi — ${DESCRIPTION}"
  echo ""
  echo "Commands:"
  echo "  status       Show current state at a glance"
  echo "  list         List managed files [--changed] [--encrypted]"
  echo "  diff         Show diffs between source and installed"
  echo "  graph        Show relationship graph [--full] [--nodes N] [--edges N] [--output <file>]"
  echo "  add          Add file to source state [--encrypt]"
  echo "  re-add       Capture on-disk changes [--all]"
  echo "  apply        Apply source state to installed files"
  echo "  verify       Check files match source state"
  echo "  sync         Pull remote and apply [--preview] [--force] [--branch <name>]"
  echo "  commit       Commit, push, and open PR"
  echo "  help         Show this help"
  echo ""
  echo "Run \`chezmoi-axi <command> --help\` for command-specific help"
}

# --- Main ---

main() {
  local cmd="${1:-status}"
  shift || true

  case "$cmd" in
    status)   cmd_status "$@" ;;
    list|ls)  cmd_list "$@" ;;
    diff)     cmd_diff "$@" ;;
    graph)    cmd_graph "$@" ;;
    add)      cmd_add "$@" ;;
    re-add)   cmd_readd "$@" ;;
    apply)    cmd_apply "$@" ;;
    verify)   cmd_verify "$@" ;;
    sync)     cmd_sync "$@" ;;
    commit)   cmd_commit "$@" ;;
    help|-h|--help) cmd_help "$@" ;;
    *)
      echo "error: unknown command: $cmd"
      echo "help: valid commands: status, list, diff, graph, add, re-add, apply, verify, sync, commit, help"
      exit 2
      ;;
  esac
}

main "$@"
